axes.model_access: The consumer app and the API line share the official model family: api-docs.deepseek.com's official docs list model names and version records (the news page carries model-update announcements); in-app model tiers are per what the signed-in UI shows. The open-weight line (HF/ModelScope) is the same vendor's other face — running locally belongs to the runner dossiers.
axes.runtime: Web (chat.deepseek.com) + iOS/Android apps; generation is processed on the vendor's cloud, no model runs locally. The API line (platform.deepseek.com) is the developer entry — same vendor, two interfaces alongside the chat product.
axes.local_files: Chat history is stored on the account side; uploaded-file parsing happens in the cloud. No locally-oriented data surface declared by the official side — the chat product does not carry local files.
axes.background: Chats return instantly with no offline task-queue form (no background-task surface declared officially); the "Deep Thinking" mode is an in-session reasoning-tier switch, not an async task.
axes.tools: Web search and file parsing are in-product capability lines; no self-built agent/workflow surface (not declared officially). No official statement verified for MCP support.
axes.context: Session history is organized per conversation and syncs when signed in; no official statement verified for a cross-session memory mechanism (if unknown, say unknown). Context length is decided by the model tier; the official docs have a model-parameters page.
axes.permissions: Account system (phone-number registration); the training-use terms are in the official privacy policy and the dedicated "Model Mechanism and Training Methods" page (entry seen via direct fetch of cdn.deepseek.com); the exact switch path not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Suits: Chinese reasoning-oriented Q&A, wanting traceable official model documentation (the API docs quality stands out among domestic products), open weights and cloud being the same family with both options. Does not suit: background long tasks/workflows, or ecosystem integration (office/social suites).
